subject: sw-11: Kai progress story page -- score history narrative
body:
## Kai Progress Story Page Spec

Date: 2026-02-24
Filed by: GD
Scope: New page or dashboard section

### Problem

Kai takes 10 practice exams but has no narrative view of his improvement arc. The dashboard shows current scores but not the story: 'You were at 60% on RP1, and now you're hitting 85% on RP8. That's real progress.'

The sparkline widget on the dashboard is a step. But it's a mini chart -- not a story.

### Proposed Feature: Progress Story Card

A new card on the dashboard (below the Up Next card) that narrates Kai's growth.

### Visual Spec

**Card structure:**
```
[Progress Story card]

Your Algebra II journey

RP1: 58%  RP2: 64%  RP3: 72%  RP4: 78%  [current: 83% RP8]
     +6         +8         +6         +5 (progress)

'You've improved 25 points since your first exam. Keep it up.'

[See full scorecard button]
```

**Display rules:**
- Only appears when Kai has at least 3 exam results in localStorage
- Shows last 5 exams (or fewer if < 5 taken)
- Each exam: shows practice number + score
- Between exams: shows delta (+N or -N)
- Positive delta: --color-correct green
- Negative delta: --color-incorrect red
- Zero delta: --text-secondary gray
- Bottom narrative: one sentence, generated from the data
- Max 5 exams shown. Scrollable if more than 5 (or show last 5 only)

**Narrative copy rules:**
- If overall trend is up: 'You have improved N points since {first shown exam}. Keep it up.'
- If overall trend is flat (+/- 3 points): 'Consistent scores across your last {N} exams. Push for the next level.'
- If overall trend is down: 'Scores dipped lately. Review your weakest standard and hit it again.'
- N = current score minus first shown score
- MCM voice: direct, specific, no em dashes

### State Machine

States: EMPTY | INSUFFICIENT_DATA | VISIBLE

- EMPTY: No localStorage results found -> card not rendered at all
- INSUFFICIENT_DATA: 1-2 exams taken -> card not rendered (need 3 minimum for story)
- VISIBLE: 3+ exams -> card renders with data

Transition: EMPTY -> INSUFFICIENT_DATA on any exam completion. INSUFFICIENT_DATA -> VISIBLE when 3rd result is saved.

### Data Source

Reads from localStorage: same key as dashboard score display.
Fields needed: exam identifier (e.g., 'retake-practice-1'), score percentage, completion date.

**Note to GA:** If completion date is not stored in localStorage results, the Progress Story card can omit dates and show exams in result-insertion order. Do not add date storage just for this feature.

### Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] Card not shown until 3+ results in localStorage
- [ ] Shows up to 5 most recent exam results
- [ ] Exam IDs displayed in human-readable format ('RP1', 'RP2', etc. or 'Practice 1')
- [ ] Score shown as percentage (e.g., '72%')
- [ ] Delta between consecutive exams shown with color coding
- [ ] Narrative copy selected based on overall trend rule above
- [ ] No em dashes in any copy
- [ ] Card responds to score-error-banner (if score data error, card degrades gracefully -- do not crash)

### What NOT to Change

- Up Next card (separate, above this card)
- Dashboard score display (existing, separate component)
- localStorage schema (read only, no new writes)

### Scope

File: index.html
CSS: new .progress-story-card class. Use --bg-card, --text-primary, --text-secondary, --color-correct, --color-incorrect tokens.

### Priority

Normal. This is a new feature. Do not implement until answer format guidance (sw-17) is QA'd first.
